strings.title: Battery systems
strings.description: Say whether you want to track home battery systems. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery)

strings.title: Add battery system
strings.description: Configure a battery/inverter system. Only charge and discharge energy sensors are required. If you enable advanced fields, the next step will ask for optional capacity, power limits, and SOC bounds. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_add)

fields.label: Charging power sensor (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous power currently going into the battery (not a max value).

fields.label: Discharging power sensor (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous power currently drawn from the battery (not a max value).

fields.label: Net power sensor (W, optional, signed)
fields.description: Use this if you have a single signed sensor instead of separate charge/discharge. If you set charge + discharge sensors, you can leave this empty.

fields.label: State of charge (%, optional)
fields.description: Optional percentage sensor (0–100). Used for the SOC bar and ETA.

fields.label: Show advanced battery fields
fields.description: Opens a separate step for nominal capacity (kWh), charge/discharge limits (W), and SOC min/max.

strings.title: Battery advanced settings
strings.description: Battery #{battery_number}: for each setting, two rows share the same title: first a sensor/helper, then a manual value. Only fill one of the two rows (not both). [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_advanced)

fields.label: Nominal capacity — sensor or helper
fields.description: Nominal capacity at 100% SOC (max storable energy, kWh). Numeric value in kWh (e.g. sensor, input_number). Use when the value comes from an entity.

fields.label: Nominal capacity — manual entry
fields.description: Nominal capacity at 100% SOC (max storable energy, kWh). Enter here or use the entity above — only one of the two.

fields.label: Max charge power — sensor or helper
fields.description: Technical limit in W read from an entity.

fields.label: Max charge power — manual entry
fields.description: Technical limit in W (not your instantaneous measured power).

fields.label: Max discharge power — sensor or helper
fields.description: Technical limit in W read from an entity.

fields.label: Max discharge power — manual entry
fields.description: Technical limit in W (not your instantaneous measured power).

fields.label: SOC minimum — sensor or helper
fields.description: Percent 0–100 from an entity.

fields.label: SOC minimum — manual entry
fields.description: Use if the battery never reaches 0%.

fields.label: SOC maximum — sensor or helper
fields.description: Percent 0–100 from an entity.

fields.label: SOC maximum — manual entry
fields.description: Use if the battery never reaches 100%.

strings.title: More batteries?
strings.description: You can add more battery systems or continue. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_more)

strings.title: Contract details
strings.description: Enter your subscribed power (kVA) and an optional contract label. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-contract)

strings.title: EDF offer selection
strings.description: Choose how your EDF offer is priced: BASE, HPHC, or Tempo. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_offer)

strings.title: Tempo signal source
strings.description: RTE is the most reliable source but requires credentials. API Couleur Tempo works without credentials and is easier to set up. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_tempo)

strings.title: RTE credentials
strings.description: Enter your RTE API credentials to fetch the Tempo calendar from the official source. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_tempo_rte)

strings.title: Grid energy sensors
strings.description: Configure your grid energy measurement sensors. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid)

fields.label: Grid import energy (kWh)
fields.description: Total increasing energy counter for grid import.

fields.label: Grid export energy (kWh, optional)
fields.description: Total increasing energy counter for grid export (if separate from import).

fields.label: Grid power (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous grid power for real-time display.

fields.label: Grid power sign convention
fields.description: Convention: is export negative or positive on this sensor?

strings.title: Three-phase grid sensors (JSON)
strings.description: Optional JSON lists: either one entry for a total sensor or one entry per phase (see template). Leave fields empty to skip. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_phases)

strings.title: Three-phase grid import
strings.description: Does your installation expose one total import counter for the whole grid, or one counter per phase? [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_energy_mode)

fields.label: Grid import metering
fields.description: One total: you will pick a single import sensor next. One per phase: the integration sums L1+L2+L3 for accounting.

strings.title: Three-phase sensor layout
strings.description: Choose how you want to enter optional per-phase sensors (import/export energy and grid power). Your main grid sensors from the previous step stay as the primary totals. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_layout)

fields.label: Sensor layout
fields.description: One for all phases: next step uses JSON lists (one total or multiple phases). One per phase: the next three steps ask for phase L1, L2, and L3 separately.

strings.title: Three-phase import meters
strings.description: Select one import energy sensor per phase. Optional: three export sensors (all or none). [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_per_phase)

fields.label: Grid power sign convention
fields.description: Convention: is export negative or positive on your per-phase grid power sensors?

fields.label: House load power (W, optional)
fields.description: Optional house consumption for load-side diagnostics.

fields.label: Phase L1 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)
Phase L2 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)
Phase L3 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)
Phase L1 — grid power (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous power on L1; the integration sums whichever phases you set for real-time display. For a single total sensor, fill only one phase.

fields.label: Phase L2 — grid power (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous power on L2.

fields.label: Phase L3 — grid power (W, optional)
fields.description: Instantaneous power on L3.

strings.title: Flat tariff
strings.description: Enter your single kWh energy price and optional monthly subscription. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_flat)

strings.title: Pricing structure
strings.description: Choose how your manual tariff is modeled. Pick the option that best matches how your bill is structured. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_pricing)

fields.label: Pricing type
fields.description: Single rate: one kWh price. Peak/off-peak: time windows with different prices (e.g. off-peak nights). Advanced: slots per day type.

strings.title: Advanced schedule
strings.description: Choose how to enter your tariff slots. Full JSON format and examples: {doc_url} [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule)

strings.title: Advanced schedule — form
strings.description: Fill one row per slot (up to 6). Leave unused rows empty. See {doc_url} for midnight ranges and day types. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule_form)

strings.title: Advanced schedule — JSON
strings.description: Paste a JSON array of slots. Specification: {doc_url} [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule_json)

strings.title: Time-of-use tariff
strings.description: Define off-peak (HC) and peak (HP) windows and their kWh prices. Use advanced schedule for more than two bands. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_tou)

strings.title: Solar configuration
strings.description: Say whether you want to track solar production in this integration. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar)

fields.label: Solar energy production (kWh)
fields.description: Total increasing energy counter for solar production.

fields.label: Solar power (W, optional)
fields.description: Improves real-time power display and power-balance diagnostics.

fields.label: Export tariff (per kWh)
fields.description: Re-sale price per kWh for exported solar energy.

strings.title: Solar configuration
strings.description: Select the solar production sensors. Optional: resale and estimation. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar_config)

fields.label: Solar energy production (kWh)
fields.description: Total increasing energy counter for solar production.

fields.label: Solar power (W, optional)
fields.description: Improves real-time power display and power-balance diagnostics.

fields.label: Solar export re-sale contract?
fields.description: Enable if you have a contract that pays you for exported solar energy.

fields.label: Export tariff (per kWh)
fields.description: Re-sale price per kWh for exported solar energy.

fields.label: Enable production estimation?
fields.description: Adds an estimation model to complement real solar measurements.

strings.title: Solar production estimation
strings.description: Optional: configure PV estimation when you enable it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar_estimation)

strings.title: Custom supplier
strings.description: You chose Other as your energy supplier. Enter a short name for dashboards and entity labels (for example the name on your bill). Tariffs are entered manually when there is no automatic feed for this provider. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-supplier_custom)

fields.label: Supplier display name
fields.description: Required. A brand name or abbreviation is enough.

strings.title: Tariff retrieval mode
strings.description: Choose how tariffs should be configured. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tariff_mode)

fields.label: Tariff mode
fields.description: Auto: fetch tariffs from provider API. Manual: enter rates yourself.

strings.title: Tariff configuration
strings.description: Automatic tariff retrieval is not yet available for this supplier. Rates must be entered manually. If auto-retrieval becomes available later, a migration path will be provided without affecting historical data. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tariff_mode_manual_only)

strings.title: Three-phase grid — phase L1
strings.description: Optional sensors for phase 1. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_1)

strings.title: Three-phase grid — phase L2
strings.description: Optional sensors for phase 2. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_2)

strings.title: Three-phase grid — phase L3
strings.description: Optional sensors for phase 3. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_3)

strings.title: Hub Énergie – Setup
strings.description: Configure your energy monitoring integration. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-user)

fields.label: Energy supplier
fields.description: Select your energy supplier. Choose 'Other' for non-EDF providers.

fields.label: Phase type
fields.description: Single-phase (mono) or three-phase (tri) installation.

scenarios.title: Tempo · RTE (mono, no battery)
scenarios.note: After valid RTE credentials the integration fetches EDF tariffs internally, then continues to grid.

scenarios.title: Tempo · API Couleur (mono, no battery)
scenarios.note: Choose API Couleur on the Tempo source step. Tariffs are fetched before grid.
